description: This file handles the retrieval, mapping, saving, and redirecting of contact-opportunity relationship data within the SuiteCRM application. It initializes a relationship object, populates its fields from request data, saves it, and then redirects to an appropriate URL.

classes.name: ContactOpportunityRelationship
classes.description: Represents the contact-opportunity relationship in suiteCRM and provides methods to retrieve and save the relationship data.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches a relationship record by ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current state of the relationship object to the database.
